headline: ACME Solar appoints Nikhil Dhingra as Joint Managing Director and CEO
summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Nikhil Dhingra as Joint Managing Director and CEO, effective October 3, 2026. This appointment remains subject to the approval of the company's members. headline: Acme Solar operationalizes additional BESS capacity in Rajasthan
hook: New battery capacity added in Rajasthan
summary: Acme Solar Holdings has operationalized an additional cumulative Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) capacity of 107.36 MW / 437.49 MWh in Rajasthan. This expansion enhances the company's operational portfolio in renewable energy storage. Retail investors tracking green energy assets should note this capacity addition strengthens the company's infrastructure footprint.
why_it_matters: Expanded storage capacity strengthens Acme Solar's operational footprint.

headline: ACME Solar commissions BESS component of Rajasthan project
hook: ACME Solar partially activates Rajasthan energy project
summary: ACME Solar has officially commissioned the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) component of its project in Rajasthan. The renewable energy generation portion of the facility is still under development. This milestone marks a step forward in the company's infrastructure rollout. Retail investors should note that the project's full revenue potential remains contingent on the completion of the generation unit.
why_it_matters: Operational progress signals potential future revenue growth for the company.

summary: Acme Solar Holdings has announced the commencement of commercial production and operations for its Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) project. For Indian retail investors, operational updates on renewable assets signal progress in execution capabilities for listed green energy players.
